resources.string: Notifications at the start of important Islamic dates

string-array.name: notification_event_titles
string-array.item: Today is the Day of Arafah

string-array.name: notification_event_messages
string-array.item: Awal Muharram — may the new year be better than the last.
10 Muharram — fasting on Ashura is encouraged.
12 Rabiulawal — blessings and peace upon Prophet Muhammad SAW.
27 Rejab — remembering the night journey of Prophet Muhammad SAW.
1 Ramadan — may Allah accept our fasting.
17 Ramadan — remembering the revelation of the Quran.
1 Syawal — Eid greetings from Waktu Solat DZ.
9 Zulhijjah — a day for prayer and fasting.
10 Zulhijjah — may your acts of worship be accepted.
